name: Aenn VonCore
bio:
Aenn VonCore is a highly skilled tattoo artist based in AU, Switzerland, renowned for their expertise in creating stunning watercolor and illustrative tattoos. Their unique approach combines avant-garde elements with abstract and colorful designs, ensuring each piece of skin art they produce is a one-of-a-kind masterpiece. Aenn's professionalism is evident in every aspect of their work, from the initial design to the finished tattoo, ensuring clients leave with both a beautiful piece of art and a positive experience.
Price: $
Current location: Au, St Gallen, Switzerland
